docs.title: Valeria Puzikova
docs.text:
CFD researcher and software developer with 15+ years of experience

Currently, I lead a team developing high-performance libraries for computation and data processing. Previously, I worked on physics engines at Huawei Moscow Research Center, on immersed-boundary methods at the Ivannikov Institute for System Programming RAS, and in industry at Fortum and other companies. I hold a PhD in Physics and Mathematics from Bauman Moscow State Technical University, where I also taught optimization methods and core undergraduate mathematics. I have authored 50+ papers, a textbook on non-Newtonian fluids, and 14 registered software programs.

docs.title: Conferences and talks
docs.text: Many results related to LS-STAG, high-performance computing (HPC), numerical simulation software, and RISC-V have been presented at peer-reviewed conferences, in educational programs, and at industry events. docs.title: Scientific visualization
docs.text: SciVis (scientific visualization) is the visual side of simulation results: velocity fields, streamlines, isosurfaces, particle trajectories and animations. This page collects short clips from LS-STAG and LS-STAG-3D simulations. Each clip is muted and loops; the poster frame is shown until you press play. Click a clip to play it.

docs.title: Method
docs.text: All clips come from the LS-STAG family. The solver uses a Cartesian cut-cell mesh and a level-set representation of the immersed boundary; moving bodies are handled without remeshing. The 3D cases use the 3D extension (LS-STAG-3D), while the 2D cases use the two-dimensional solver. Colours show the velocity field unless noted; the scales are qualitative and kept from the simulation output.

docs.title: Software
docs.text: I develop and maintain numerical software for computational fluid dynamics. The main line of work is the LS-STAG family of immersed-boundary / cut-cell solvers; the open-source cfd-vv-suite project grew out of the need for reproducible verification and validation.

docs.title: LS-STAG-3D
docs.text:
LS-STAG-3D is the 3D extension of the LS-STAG immersed-boundary method for incompressible flows with moving bodies of arbitrary shape, including rotors and other coupled FSI problems. The code repository is named LS-STAG-3D_parallel. The numerical method implemented there is LS-STAG-3D, which I developed and continue to advance.

Scope:

  • 3D cut-cell discretisation with a level-set representation of arbitrary moving bodies
  • staggered Cartesian meshes
  • ALE mesh motion and an incompressible Navier–Stokes solver with fluid–structure interaction
  • coupled aeroelastic and hydroelastic problems

Repository: github.com/vvp-cfd/LS-STAG-3D_parallel Visualizations: SciVis

Earlier members of the family include 2D solvers for turbulence, viscoelastic and generalized Newtonian fluids, as well as domain-decomposition and GPU versions. Their registrations are listed below.

docs.title: cfd-vv-suite
docs.text:
An open test suite for verification and validation of CFD codes. It provides a standardised, reproducible, solver-agnostic workflow: the user supplies results as CSV, and the CLI compares them with reference data, computes error norms and generates reports.

  • 58 cases: 51 built-in and 7 imported
  • verification and validation cases for incompressible, compressible, non-Newtonian, turbulent and moving-body flows
  • OpenFOAM integration and Docker images
  • Python package cfdvv (v0.6.0 on PyPI)

Links: GitHub · Documentation · PyPI 0.6.0 · Docker · Zenodo DOI
